sql:
SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
  COCO_QBR_DEMO.ANALYTICS.QBR_FINANCE
  DIMENSIONS finance.region
  METRICS finance.actual_revenue, finance.budget_revenue, finance.revenue_variance,
    finance.revenue_variance_pct, finance.gross_profit, finance.gross_margin
  WHERE finance.quarter = '2026-Q3'
) ORDER BY actual_revenue DESC, region ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
  COCO_QBR_DEMO.ANALYTICS.QBR_FINANCE
  DIMENSIONS finance.customer
  METRICS finance.actual_revenue, finance.budget_revenue, finance.revenue_variance,
    finance.revenue_variance_pct, finance.gross_profit, finance.gross_margin
  WHERE finance.quarter = '2026-Q3' AND finance.region = 'EMEA' AND finance.segment = 'Enterprise'
) ORDER BY actual_revenue DESC, customer ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
  COCO_QBR_DEMO.ANALYTICS.QBR_FINANCE
  DIMENSIONS finance.customer
  METRICS finance.actual_revenue, finance.budget_revenue, finance.revenue_variance,
    finance.revenue_variance_pct, finance.gross_profit, finance.gross_margin
  WHERE finance.quarter = '2026-Q3' AND finance.region = 'EMEA' AND finance.segment = 'Enterprise' AND finance.customer <> 'Atlas Industries'
) ORDER BY actual_revenue DESC, customer ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
  COCO_QBR_DEMO.ANALYTICS.QBR_FINANCE
  DIMENSIONS finance.product
  METRICS finance.actual_revenue, finance.budget_revenue, finance.revenue_variance,
    finance.revenue_variance_pct, finance.gross_profit, finance.gross_margin
  WHERE finance.quarter = '2026-Q3'
) ORDER BY actual_revenue DESC, product ASC LIMIT 500
